slices.behaviour: The calibration rule and the evidence it is read from: [calibration] in thresholds.toml, harness/calibration.py, file required on a finding at high or blocking severity, and harness return --unmet.
The calibration report and the automatic return to shadow: harness report --calibration, the weekly line, and the triage reading the effective shadow rather than the threshold alone.
slices.failure_reason: AssertionError: False is not true, on a triage record's shadow while an escape sat in the window with [review] triage_shadow set false; and nine further failures, among them argparse refusing --calibration as an unknown flag
